info.title: Knowledge API
info.description: Dynamic Knowledge Platform — documents, revisions, ingestion, search

bearer.description: kn_ API key or ks_ session token (AUTH_MODE=api-key)

token.description: kr_ token from the reset link

password.description: Optional initial password; omit to let the user set one via password reset

disabled.description: true disables authentication for this user (soft delete)

password.description: Admin password override; revokes the user sessions

projectId.description: Owning project; must belong to workspaceId

parentId.description: Feature 08 nesting: create under this document

targetBranch.description: Defaults to the document's default branch

isDraft.description: Draft merge requests cannot be merged

assigneeId.description: Workspace member to assign; null clears the assignee

reviewerIds.description: Replace-set of reviewer user ids (workspace members)

revisionId.description: line: revision the line number refers to (source head at comment time)

line.description: line: 1-based new-side line number in the diff

excerpt.description: line: text excerpt for best-effort re-matching once the branch advances

entityKey.description: entity: graph entity key, e.g. service:identity

depth.description: Entity hops from the vector hits

relationTypes.description: Relation edge types to follow (default: all)

categories.description: Only return documents in these categories (feature 02)

projectIds.description: Only return documents in these projects

query.example: SELECT documentId, targetKey, confidence FROM DEPENDS_ON

instruction.example: Draft an outline for the missing sections

question.example: Why do sessions get revoked on password reset?

text.description: Draft text (an excerpt is used as the search query)

documentId.description: Page the pane was opened from — default chat grounding

content.example: Draft a short onboarding page for new hires

documentId.description: Overrides the thread's default grounding document for this turn

mode.description: 'ask' (default) excludes write tools this turn regardless of role; 'agent' allows them (still gated by editor role)

attachments.description: Ephemeral file content for this turn only — not persisted verbatim into thread history

documentRefs.description: Existing workspace documents manually picked to ground this turn in ("Apply documents" widget)

statusCode.description: HTTP status (0 is reserved for client-synthesized errors)

code.description: Stable machine-readable code — branch on this, never on message

details.description: Machine-readable extras: validation errors[], conflict currentHeadRevisionId/comparisonUrl, …

requestId.description: Correlation id — echoed from the x-request-id request header (also set as a response header)
